title: AN OUTFIT TILE SHOWS THE OUTFIT
why: Seen on the 4K FASHION screenshot of 2026-10-07: every tile on the OUTFIT rack was the same placeholder, a coloured square with a dot, so the Skeleton, the Machine, the Trooper and the rest could not be told apart without wearing them. Each tile now shows your own operator wearing that outfit, drawn the same way as the big YOUR OPERATOR figure, locked outfits included so you can see what you are working toward.
now: The FASHION outfit tiles show your operator wearing each outfit.
